WITH inflow AS (
  SELECT 
    TO_CHAR(t.date, 'YYYY-MM') AS year_month,
    SUM(t.amount) AS sum_amount
  FROM transactions AS t
  JOIN accounts AS a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE a.account_type = 'Checking'
    AND a.bank = '$bank'
    AND t.flow_type = 'inflow'
    AND $__timeFilter(t.date)
  GROUP BY year_month
  ORDER BY year_month
), outflow AS (
  SELECT 
    TO_CHAR(t.date, 'YYYY-MM') AS year_month,
    SUM(t.amount) AS sum_amount
  FROM transactions AS t
  JOIN accounts AS a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE a.account_type = 'Checking'
    AND a.bank = '$bank'
    AND t.flow_type = 'outflow'
    AND $__timeFilter(t.date)
  GROUP BY year_month
  ORDER BY year_month
)
SELECT
  i.year_month,
  i.sum_amount AS "In-Flow",
  i.sum_amount + o.sum_amount AS "Net-Flow",
  o.sum_amount AS "Out-Flow"
FROM inflow AS i
JOIN outflow AS o ON i.year_month = o.year_month

WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT
    a.account_type,
    percentile_cont(0.05) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.amount) AS p05,
    percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.amount) AS p95
  FROM transactions AS t
  JOIN accounts a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(t.date)
    AND t.merchant = 'Payroll'
  GROUP BY a.account_type
), 
filtered_avgs AS (
  SELECT
    a.account_type,
    AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amount
  FROM transactions t
  JOIN accounts a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN bounds b
    ON b.account_type = a.account_type
  WHERE $__timeFilter(t.date)
    AND t.amount BETWEEN b.p05 AND b.p95
  GROUP BY a.account_type
)
SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(avg_amount), 2) AS total_avg
FROM filtered_avgs;

SELECT SUM(amount) AS "Total Income"
FROM transactions AS t
  JOIN accounts AS a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE a.account_type = 'Checking'
    AND (t.subcategory != 'Savings Transfers'
      AND t.merchant != 'Payroll')
    AND t.flow_type = 'inflow'
    AND $__timeFilter(t.date)

SELECT 
  TO_CHAR(t.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Date",
  t.merchant AS "Merchant",
  t.category AS "Category",
  t.amount AS "Amount"
FROM transactions AS t
  JOIN accounts AS a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE a.account_type = 'Checking'
    AND (t.subcategory != 'Savings Transfers'
      AND t.merchant != 'Payroll')
    AND t.flow_type = 'inflow'
    AND $__timeFilter(t.date)
ORDER BY "Date"

WITH latest_month AS (
  SELECT MAX(date_trunc('month', date)) AS month_start
  FROM transactions
)
SELECT
  TO_CHAR(date_trunc('month', date), 'YYYY-MM') AS "Current Month"
FROM transactions, latest_month
WHERE date_trunc('month', date) = latest_month.month_start
LIMIT 1

WITH latest_month AS (
  SELECT MAX(date_trunc('month', date)) AS month_start
  FROM transactions
)
SELECT
  SUM(amount) AS current_expenses
FROM transactions, latest_month
WHERE date_trunc('month', date) = latest_month.month_start
  AND flow_type = 'inflow'

WITH latest_month AS (
  SELECT MAX(date_trunc('month', date)) AS month_start
  FROM transactions
)
SELECT
  SUM(amount) AS current_expenses
FROM transactions, latest_month
WHERE date_trunc('month', date) = latest_month.month_start
  AND flow_type = 'outflow'
  AND is_recurring = 't'

WITH latest_month AS (
  SELECT MAX(date_trunc('month', date)) AS month_start
  FROM transactions
)
SELECT
  subcategory,
  SUM(amount) * -1 AS current_expenses
FROM transactions, latest_month
WHERE date_trunc('month', date) = latest_month.month_start
  AND flow_type = 'outflow'
  AND is_recurring = 't'
GROUP BY subcategory
ORDER BY current_expenses;
